purpose: Define distributed/runtime traces and spans as explicit execution-correlation evidence across commands, Runner steps, tools, protocols and DWH operations.

topics.name: Runtime Trace and Span
topics.purpose: Define distributed/runtime traces and spans as explicit execution-correlation evidence across commands, Runner steps, tools, protocols and DWH operations.

semantics.trace_rule: Each trace has an explicit trace identity.
semantics.span_rule: Each span has an explicit span identity and exact parent/trace refs.
semantics.causality_rule: Span parentage may reflect execution structure but does not replace canonical causality edges where effect causation matters.
semantics.cross_boundary_rule: Trace context propagation across protocol/tool boundaries is explicit.
semantics.authority_rule: Trace context grants no operation authority.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant definitions, executions, evidence and runtime state use explicit identities and boundaries; visibility, file order, timestamps, transport reachability or UI placement never silently create semantic authority.

hard_gates.condition: span parentage replaces causal Event graph automatically
